title: Unsupervised machine learning builds an Alzheimer's progression risk score
summary: An AD risk score was derived with unsupervised machine learning from cerebrospinal fluid, MRI and cognitive measures in 226 cognitively normal individuals and validated in an independent cohort. Higher baseline scores were associated with progression to symptomatic AD (hazard ratio 2.70). The authors report high predictive accuracy for clinical decline within 5 years; the study is observational with a small development cohort.
